title: Final Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the angle theta at which the particle leaves the sphere.

title: Final Speed
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the speed v of the particle at the moment it leaves the sphere.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the conservation of energy principle to relate potential and kinetic energy.

title: Radial Force Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the radial force equation correctly to find when the particle leaves the sphere.

title: Parabolic Trajectory
description: Optional Criteria: The student should describe the particle's motion after leaving the sphere as a parabolic trajectory.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or energy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
